title: Lunch-order service
passage:
Cedar Kitchen — Office lunch orders

Orders placed by 10:30 a.m. are delivered between noon and 12:30 p.m. Our standard set includes a main dish, rice, and seasonal vegetables. A vegetarian set is available at the same price. Drinks are ordered separately.

Delivery is free for orders of ten sets or more to one address. Smaller orders incur a delivery fee of NT$60. Please designate one person to receive and check the entire order.

Changes to the quantity or meal selection can be made until 10:45 a.m. After that time, the kitchen starts packing and cannot accept changes. We do not offer evening delivery.
passageZh:
Cedar Kitchen——辦公室午餐訂購

最遲於上午十點半下單，將於中午十二點至下午十二點半送達。標準套餐包含主菜、飯及時令蔬菜，也有同價的素食套餐。飲料須另行訂購。

十份以上送至同一地址免運，未達十份收取新臺幣六十元運費。請指定一人接收並核對整筆訂單。

更改數量或餐點選擇的截止時間為上午十點四十五分；之後廚房開始裝餐，無法接受更改。我們不提供晚間外送。
